stemMarkdown: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 20, 24 and 40 hours respectively. If all three are opened together, how many hours will the tank take to fill? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Combined rate $= \dfrac{1}{20} + \dfrac{1}{24} + \dfrac{1}{40} = 0.116667$ tanks per hour, so the time is $8.5714$ hours.
